name.zh: 猛犸象（真猛犸象启发成年形态）

scope: Original static evidence-informed whole adult mammoth, not same-specimen replica or reused Mammut. Existing planned genus ID.

taxon.context: Late Pleistocene cold-adapted elephant; no universal co-occurrence or specific scene claim.
anchors: Grigoriev et al2017 Malolyakhovsky adult female carcass, Figs3–6

scale.basis: Artist nominal adult targets, not one measured individual. MNHN reports 2.70×4.85×1.70m mount; paper estimates female shoulder2.40m. Do not equate posed bounds to those observations.

pose: Quiet four-foot stance, head -Y, trunk lowered with tip slightly inward; two tusks sweep forward/out then upward/in in three dimensions without crossing trunk. Tail short and relaxed; no stand or terrain.

surface_profile.name: palette-only
surface_profile.materials: 4–6 muted warm/chocolate gray-browns with ivory tusks, dark eyes/nose, no exact pigment claim.
surface_profile.detail: Broad overlapping fur masses/small selected tapering locks, not thousands of hairs, sharp cones everywhere or modern elephant smoothness. Single-sided solid geometry only.

coordinates.origin: Ground plane footprint center; all four feet grounded.

view_plan.source: Exact final GLB clean-import; stable numeric cameras/light/color config and hash-bound full resolution manifest.
view_plan.greybox: All around before expensive polish; inspect head/shoulders/tusks/feet silhouette.
view_plan.extra_views: Only targeted diagnostic if a concrete unresolved issue; no default8 required for scoped model making.

scientific_limits: Whole-body volume, pose, hair distribution/colors and precise ear/tail silhouette are conservative art choices, not fossil-exact reconstruction.
MNHN MAQ287 museum mount is male; carcass is an older female. Composite form anchors do not imply same individual or sex-specific dimensions.
No source-image textures, scans or meshes incorporated. No use of old museum model or Mammut geometry.
Tusks vary by age/sex/individual. Preserve double curvature, not universal exact tusk shape or count of growth bands.
Trunk tip damaged in studied carcass; do not present exposed cut end as life anatomy. Small understated paired prehensile tip region is interpretive, not measured here.
Molar lamellae distinguish elephant dentition, but mouth remains closed so do not invent a visible tooth row.

morphology.obligation: High domed cranium, high shoulder region and back sloping toward lower rump; must be distinct from low-headed mastodon. Maintain separate head/neck/shoulder transitions without visible primitive spheres.
morphology.source: NHM Lister account; actual MAQ287 skull profile.

morphology.obligation: Exactly2 upper tusks, continuous taper from upper-face roots, curving forward/outward/upward/inward in 3D; not flat semicircles, straight spears, lower tusks or duplicated rings. Clearance from trunk and ground in every required view.
morphology.source: MAQ287 actual skull/tusk photo; Grigoriev2017 Fig4.

morphology.obligation: One muscular continuous tapering trunk rooted between tusks, hanging with relaxed distal bend; readable tip without huge drilled nostrils. Do not retain taphonomic bends/injuries of specimen.
Small ears close to head, short slim tail with understated terminal hair. Do not use large fan elephant ears.
morphology.source: NHM mammoth expert account; exact soft geometry art.

morphology.obligation: Deep compact hairy trunk, four load-bearing columnar limbs with broad rounded feet, clear inter-leg negative spaces, cohesive belly/hip/shoulder. No exposed bones, giant toe claws or animal armor.
morphology.source: Elephant whole-body anatomy anchored museum specimen/context; art volumes declared.

acceptance_obligations: Exactly front/side/top/perspective for current model-task-v2 scoped making and independent QA; specific issues may require targeted diagnostics. Do not claim full production acceptance.

Perspective confirms coherent form/tusk clearance; front paired tusks/small ears/one trunk; side domed head/sloping back; top3D tusk curvature and width. Check rear limbs/tail in perspective; add rear/clay only for actual ambiguity.

All4 intended feet contact floor; no self-intersecting tusks/trunk, detached coat fragments or repeated bead limbs. Compare distinctness against existing Mammut only for differentiation, not as source template.
Two complete builds; single-sided culling checks; default helper; source and exactGLB bounds/counts; official validation and separate runtime gates.
Independent QA separate from maker. No user acceptance/GPU scene/deploy claim unless actually evidenced.
production_boundary: Full static-stylized-v1 production8/GPU/scene contract is retained as reference but NOT claimed passed or imposed as current maker scope; user-requested4view model acceptance is separate.
